name: [🧠BRAINROT] Clone Run!
desc:
👋 Welcome to Clone Run!

Race to the end with your army of clones and gather even more clones along the way to defeat the final boss!

⭐ UPDATE 5 ⭐
- SHOP REVAMP!
- POTIONS!
- A BUNCH OF FIXES AND BALANCING CHANGES!

👍Leave a LIKE if you enjoyed the game!
⭐Make sure to STAR the game so you can find it again!

*If you are lagging then your clone cap will be reduced to prevent lag. This does not mean you lose strength, as your clones will be upgraded.
